Maya (config): Quick sync: small feature request to add a compact preview artifact for runtime edits (route/quota tweaks). Want minimal UI and safe defaults. Thoughts?

Ike (console): Love it. Minimal preview should include: preview_id, changed keys list, human estimate of affected tenants, and a small diff view. Dry-run only, no locks by default.

Rina (sre): Need safety gates: max batch 250 keys, reject if estimated RPS change >40% for any shard, and require ops ack for >1000 tenants. Also an auto-pause threshold for +2% absolute error increase within 10m.

Paul (telemetry): Preview must snapshot baseline metrics (rps_1m, p95_latency, 5xx_rate) and attach snapshot_id. We'll emit a compact report every 60s for the first 15m. Add X-Preview-Id header for replay/traces.

Maya (config): Example call: POST /api/v1/config/preview body: {"changes":[{"path":"tenants/T42/quota","value":800}],"dry_run":true} -> returns preview_id & snapshot_id. Console should surface "export preview" JSON.

Ike (console): UI: two-column diff + tiny timeline (created, validated, ttl). Include "require approvals" toggle for large patches. Also add an "apply as canary" option (1% traffic).

Rina (sre): Canary flow: apply to 1% for 30m with cooldown steps. If any shard sees +1% absolute errors or +25% relative latency, auto-revert and page oncall.

Paul (telemetry): Will add collector tag and lightweight report proto: "preview_id|snapshot_id|ts|metric:baseline:current:delta" lines. PR incoming.

ops-bot: Reminder: config-service maintenance 02:00-03:00 UTC tomorrow. Avoid big config operations then.

Maya (config): Action items: Ike -> preview endpoint + UI POC, Paul -> tag & report, Rina -> runbook snippet. I'll coordinate approvals. Put preview_id:1732000000 in PRs.

Ike (console): Ack.

Paul (telemetry): On it.

Rina (sre): Thanks team.

Maya (config): Closing.
